chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa from Nuh b. Shu'ayb al-Nishapuri from Ubaydullah b. Abdullah al-Dahqan from Urwa the nephew of Shu'ayb al-Aqraquqi from Shu'ayb from Abi Basir. He said: I heard al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both) narrating from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said one day to his companions: Which of you fast the whole year? So, Salman (may Allah's mercy be upon him) said: I, O Messenger of Allah. So, the Messenger of Allah said: So, which of you keep vigil at night? So, Salman said: I, O Messenger of Allah. He said: So, which of you completes the Quran every day? So, Salman said: I, O Messenger of Allah. So, one of his companions became angry and said: O Messenger of Allah! Salman is a man from Persia, and he wants to boast over us, the people of Quraysh. You said, 'Which of you fast the whole year?', and he said, 'I', when he eats on most days. You said, 'Which of you keep vigil at night?', and he said, 'I', when he sleeps most of the night. You said, 'Which of you completes the Quran everyday?', and he said, 'I', when he is silent for most of the day. So, the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) said: Cease, O person. How can you compare with Luqman the Wise? Ask him, and he will inform you.

So, the man said to Salman: O Aba Abdillah! Did you not allege that you fast every day? He said: Yes. He said: I saw you eating on most days! He said: It is not as you think. I fast three days in a month, and Allah the Mighty and Majestic said: 'Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten the like thereof.' [6:160] And I connect Sha'ban with the month of Ramadan, which is like fasting the whole year. He said: Did you not allege that you keep vigil at night? He said: Yes. He said: You sleep for most of the night! He said: It is not as you think, but I have heard my Beloved, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) say: 'Whoever goes to sleep in a state of purity, it is as though he has kept vigil all night', and I go to sleep in a state of purity.

He said: Did you not allege that you complete the Quran every day? He said: Yes. He said: But you are silent on most days. He said: It is not as you think, as I have heard my Beloved, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) say to Ali (peace be upon him): 'O Abu'l Hasan! Your likeness to my Nation is like Surat al-Tawhid (qul huwallahu ahad), for whoever recites it once has recited one third of the Quran; whoever recites it twice has recited two thirds of the Quran; and whoever recites it three times has completed the Quran. Whoever loves you with his tongue has completed one third of faith; whoever loves you with his tongue and heart has completed two thirds of faith; and whoever loves you with his tongue, heart, and supports you with his hand has perfected faith. By He who has sent me with the truth, O Ali! If the people of the Earth loved you like the people of the heavens love you, no one would be punished in the Fire.' And I recite qul huwallahu ahad three times every day. Then, the man stood as though he had been pelted with a stone.

key_terms.إحياء الليل: Keeping vigil at night — achieved through sleeping in a state of ritual purity
key_terms.الإيمان: Faith — described in three levels: tongue, tongue and heart, tongue and heart and hand
key_terms.ختم القرآن: Completing the Quran — achieved through reciting Surat al-Tawhid three times
key_terms.صوم الدهر: Fasting the whole year — achieved through fasting three days monthly with the tenfold reward principle

ai.seo_question: How did Salman al-Farsi explain his claim of fasting every day, keeping vigil every night, and completing the Quran daily?
ai.summary: The Prophet asks his companions who among them fasts every day, keeps vigil every night, and completes the Quran daily. Salman al-Farsi answers affirmatively to all three. When a Qurayshi companion objects, the Prophet compares Salman to Luqman the Wise. Salman then explains his methods: fasting three days monthly combined with Sha'ban-Ramadan connection (citing Quran 6:160), sleeping in ritual purity, and reciting Surat al-Tawhid (Quran 112:1) three times daily. This leads to the Prophet's remarkable statement comparing Ali to Surat al-Tawhid, equating love for Ali with the completion of faith.
